name: CED Las Cruces
old_description: Since 1963, I-Line circuit breakers and panelboards have been the go-to choice for electrical contractors, estimators, and end-users, thanks to their unique design and reliability. Contact us today to explore the options available to you.
about:
CED Las Cruces operates from Las Cruces, New Mexico, where it has served the local market for over 50 years. The branch is part of Consolidated Electrical Distributors (CED), a national network encompassing more than 700 locations across the United States. No founding year or ownership structure is disclosed for the Las Cruces location specifically.

The company functions as an electrical solutions distributor and product supplier, carrying a broad line of brands anchored by Schneider Electric and its Square D label. Its service portfolio includes switchgear quotations, project management, lighting quotations, lighting design packages, and delivery service. The branch emphasizes a large inventory, quick response times, competitive pricing, and a sales team whose combined experience exceeds 125 years.

Primary customers are commercial electrical contractors, residential electrical contractors, multifamily construction contractors, and hybrid construction contractors. The branch supports residential, commercial, industrial, and solar projects, supplying products such as panelboards, load centers, safety switches, and surge protection devices.

CED Las Cruces states that its policy of service, integrity, and reliability drives its operations, positioning the branch as a dependable source for electrical materials and expertise in the region.
